spanish: Y quitaré mi palma, y verás mis espaldas, y mis faces no se verán.
grammarChanges: espalda → espaldas: H268 is a masculine plural construct (hinder parts) with a 1cs suffix; the singular Spanish noun changed the number, so the plural form is used to match.
readerNote: Chose plural "espaldas" over singular "espalda" to preserve the grammatical number of the plural Hebrew noun (H268), still naming one back.
